arxiv-2109-07781.title: Factorization breaking for higher moments of harmonic flow
arxiv-2109-07781.creator: Piotr Bożek, Rupam Samanta
arxiv-2109-07781.description: Abstract We study correlations between harmonic flow vectors squared measured at different transverse momenta. One of the flow harmonics squared is taken at a fixed transverse momentum and correlated to the momentum averaged harmonic flow squared of the same order. Such four particle correlators, dependent on transverse momentum, have been recently measured experimentally.

arxiv-2209-15503.title: Kaluza-Klein theory for type I ​ I ​ b II\ b supergravity on the warped deformed conifold
arxiv-2209-15503.creator: M. Chemtob
arxiv-2209-15503.description: Abstract We discuss Kaluza-Klein theory for type I ​ I ​ b II\ b supergravity on the warped deformed conifold using a large radial distance limit of Klebanov-Strassler solution where the radial coordinate separates from angle coordinates for a background asymptotic to A ​ d ​ S 5 × T 1 , 1 AdS_{5}\times T^{1,1} spacetime.

arxiv-2210-00424.title: Dynamical history of the Galilean satellites for a fast migration of Callisto 2022 Dynamical history of the Galilean satellites for a fast migration of Callisto – References
arxiv-2210-00424.creator: Giacomo Lari, Melaine Saillenfest, Clara Grassi
arxiv-2210-00424.description: Abstract The dynamics of the innermost Galilean satellites (Io, Europa and Ganymede) is characterised by a chain of mean motion resonances, called Laplace resonance, and by a strong tidal dissipation that causes wide variations of their semi-major axes over large timescales. The precise history of energy dissipation in the Jovian system is not known, but several theories have been proposed.

arxiv-2308-08255.title: Fundamental scaling relationships revealed in the optical light curves of tidal disruption events Fundamental scaling relationships revealed in the optical light curves of tidal disruption events – E 2023
arxiv-2308-08255.creator: Andrew Mummery, Sjoert van Velzen, Edward Nathan, Adam Ingram, Erica Hammerstein, Ludovic Fraser-Taliente, Steven Balbus
arxiv-2308-08255.description: Abstract We present fundamental scaling relationships between properties of the optical/UV light curves of tidal disruption events (TDEs) and the mass of the black hole that disrupted the star. We have uncovered these relations from the late-time emission of TDEs.

arxiv-2407-13682.title: Tuning collective actuation of active solids by optimizing activity localization
arxiv-2407-13682.creator: Davi Lazzari 1, Olivier Dauchot 2, Carolina Brito 1
arxiv-2407-13682.description: Abstract Active solids, more specifically elastic lattices embedded with polar active units, exhibit collective actuation when the elasto-active feedback, generically present in such systems, exceeds some critical value. The dynamics then condensates on a small fraction of the vibrational modes, the selection of which obeys non trivial rules rooted in the nonlinear part of the dynamics.

arxiv-2411-13399.title: Numerical study of bi-layer two-orbital model for La 3 Ni 2 O 7 on a plaquette ladder
arxiv-2411-13399.creator: Yang Shen, Jiale Huang, Xiangjian Qian, Guang-Ming Zhang, Mingpu Qin
arxiv-2411-13399.description: Abstract The recently discovered high- T c T_{c} superconductivity in La 3 Ni 2 O 7 with T c ≈ 80 ​ K T_{c}\approx 80K provides another intriguing platform to explore the microscopic mechanism of unconventional superconductivity. In this work, we study a previously proposed bi-layer two-orbital model Hamiltonian for La 3 Ni 2 O 7 [Y.

arxiv-2412-01016.title: Transistors based on Novel 2-D Monolayer Semiconductors Bi 2 O 2 Se, InSe, and MoSi 2 N 4 for Enhanced Logic Density Scaling
arxiv-2412-01016.creator: Keshari Nandan, Ateeb Naseer, Amit Agarwal, Somnath Bhowmick, Yogesh S. Chauhan
arxiv-2412-01016.description: Abstract Making ultra-short gate-length transistors significantly contributes to scaling the contacted gate pitch. This, in turn, plays a vital role in achieving smaller standard logic cells for enhanced logic density scaling. As we push the boundaries of miniaturization, it is intriguing to consider that the ultimate limit of contacted gate pitch could be reached with remarkable 1 nm gate-length transistors.

arxiv-2511-07038.title: Conservative Software Reliability Assessments Using Collections of Bayesian Inference Problems
arxiv-2511-07038.creator: Kizito Salako
arxiv-2511-07038.description: Abstract When using Bayesian inference to support conservative software reliability assessments, it is useful to consider a collection of Bayesian inference problems, with the aim of determining the worst-case value (from this collection) for a posterior predictive probability that characterizes how reliable the software is.

arxiv-2512-08205.title: Primal-dual policy learning for mean-field stochastic LQR problem
arxiv-2512-08205.creator: Xiushan Jiang, Dong Wang, Weihai Zhang, Daniel W. C. Ho, Yuanqing Wu
arxiv-2512-08205.description: Abstract Integrating data-driven techniques with mechanism-driven insights has recently gained popularity as a powerful learning approach to solving traditional LQR problems for designing intelligent controllers in complex dynamic systems. However, the theoretical understanding of various reinforcement learning algorithms needs further exploration to enhance their efficiency and safety.

pmc-10569346.title: The presence of baseline HBsAb-Specific B cells can predict HBsAg or HBeAg seroconversion of chronic hepatitis B on treatment
pmc-10569346.creator: Shengxia Yin, Yawen Wan, Rahma Issa, Yijia Zhu, Xiaoming Xu, Jiacheng Liu, Minxin Mao, Ming Li, Xin Tong, Chen Tian, Jian Wang, Rui Huang, Qun Zhang, Chao Wu, Yuxin Chen, Jie Li
pmc-10569346.description: Indices for predicting HBsAg or HBeAg seroconversion in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection during antiviral therapy remain elusive. We aimed to investigate if the presence of HBsAb-specific B cells at baseline can predict HBsAg or HBeAg seroconversion. In this study, 134 treatment-naive patients with chronic HBV were enrolled.

pmc-10576830.title: Abl depletion via autophagy mediates the beneficial effects of quercetin against Alzheimer pathology across species
pmc-10576830.creator: Alfonso Schiavi, Claudia Cirotti, Lora-Sophie Gerber, Giulia Di Lauro, Silvia Maglioni, Priscila Yumi Tanaka Shibao, Sabrina Montresor, Janine Kirstein, Patrick Petzsch, Karl Köhrer, Roel P. F. Schins, Tina Wahle, Daniela Barilà, Natascia Ventura
pmc-10576830.description: Alzheimer’s disease is the most common age-associated neurodegenerative disorder and the most frequent form of dementia in our society. Aging is a complex biological process concurrently shaped by genetic, dietary and environmental factors and natural compounds are emerging for their beneficial effects against age-related disorders.

pmc-10649907.title: Targeting myeloid checkpoint Siglec-10 reactivates antitumor immunity and improves anti-programmed cell death 1 efficacy in gastric cancer
pmc-10649907.creator: Kunpeng Lv, Mengyao Sun, Hanji Fang, Jieti Wang, Chao Lin, Hao Liu, Heng Zhang, He Li, Hongyong He, Yun Gu, Ruochen Li, Fei Shao, Jiejie Xu
pmc-10649907.description: ObjectiveImmunotherapy has not yielded satisfactory therapeutic responses in gastric cancer (GC). However, targeting myeloid checkpoints holds promise for expanding the potential of immunotherapy. This study aims to evaluate the critical role of Siglec-10+ tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) in regulating antitumor immunity and to explore the potential of the myeloid checkpoint Siglec-10 as an interventional target.

pmc-10683022.title: Diester Prodrugs of a Phosphonate Butyrophilin Ligand Display Improved Cell Potency, Plasma Stability, and Payload Internalization
pmc-10683022.creator: Umed Singh, Girija Pawge, Sarita Rani, Chia-Hung Christine Hsiao, Andrew J. Wiemer, David F. Wiemer
pmc-10683022.description: Activation of Vγ9Vδ2 T cells with butyrophilin 3A1 (BTN3A1) agonists such as (E)-4-hydroxy-3-methyl-but-2-enyl diphosphate (HMBPP) has the potential to boost the immune response. Because HMBPP is highly charged and metabolically unstable, prodrugs may be needed to overcome these liabilities, but the prodrugs themselves may be limited by slow payload release or low plasma stability.

pmc-11460206.title: Blastocystis occurrence and subtype diversity in European wild boar (Sus scrofa) from the Iberian Peninsula
pmc-11460206.creator: Pamela C Köster, Ana M Figueiredo, Jenny G Maloney, Alejandro Dashti, Begoña Bailo, Rita T Torres, Carlos Fonseca, Atle Mysterud, Miguel Á Habela, Antonio Rivero-Juarez, Joaquín Vicente, Emmanuel Serrano, Maria C Arnal, Daniel Fernández de Luco, José A Armenteros, Ana Balseiro, Guillermo A Cardona,
pmc-11460206.description: The ongoing increase in wild boar populations across Europe has fostered human–wildlife conflicts, including the transmission of emerging pathogens with zoonotic importance. Blastocystis is a ubiquitous, faecal-oral transmitted protist that can cause gastrointestinal illnesses and is observed in humans and animals worldwide. The role of wildlife in the epidemiology of Blastocystis is insufficiently understood.

pmc-11770039.creator: Junhui Wang, Baize Zhang, Yujiang Chen, Lulu Wang, Yang Du, Xin Ge, Fen Liu, Jing Gong, Xiaojing Wang

pmc-12459119.title: Evidence of validity and reliability of a scale to evaluate gratitude toward the organization in the Peruvian context
pmc-12459119.creator: Edgardo Muguerza-Florián, Elizabeth Emperatriz García-Salirrosas, Miluska Villar-Guevara, Israel Fernández-Mallma
pmc-12459119.description: IntroductionDespite gratitude's potential to promote wellbeing and performance in organizational settings, its role in the workplace is understudied. Although the literature indicates few attempts to develop scales for evaluating this construct in North America, no Spanish version exists to assess the validity and reliability of these scales in other contexts.

pmc-12494259.title: Exploring the molecular and biological mechanisms of host response in chickens infected with highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (H5N1): An integrative transcriptomic analysis
pmc-12494259.creator: Sare Golpasand, Shahrokh Ghovvati, Zahra Pezeshkian
pmc-12494259.description: The H5N1 strain of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has raised worldwide alarm, posing a threat to the health of both animals and humans. The study aimed to identify key genes and biological pathways modulated in chickens infected with H5N1 through meta-analysis. Four microarray datasets from GEO were normalized using RMA, Quantile methods, and the SVA package in RStudio.

pmc-13342072.title: Quantifying cortical lesions in multiple sclerosis MRI datasets using multi-contrast post-processing and deep learning
pmc-13342072.creator: Michael G. Dwyer, Niels Bergsland, Alexander Bartnik, Dejan Jakimovski, Samantha Noteboom, Menno M. Schoonheim, Martijn D. Steenwijk, Jinglan Pei, David Clayton, Robert Zivadinov
pmc-13342072.description: BackgroundMultiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurological disease affecting both white and gray matter of the central nervous system. Despite the well-established involvement of cortical lesions in MS, feasibility limitations in their visualization on typical magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) protocols prevent their evaluation in nearly all clinical trials.

pmc-13575506.title: Effects of Short‐Term Energy Limitation at Different Levels With Normal Protein Intake on Hepatic Lipid Metabolism and the Gut Microbiota in Overweight/Obese Mice
pmc-13575506.creator: Ying Tian, Yao Tang, Mingxia Gu, Jiawei Gong, Ying Zhou, Yuqing He, Keyu Huang
pmc-13575506.description: This study investigated the sex‐specific effects of graded short‐term energy limitation (EL) with normal protein intake on hepatic lipid metabolism and the gut microbiota in overweight/obese mice. Mice were allocated to a normal control (NC) group, a high‐fat diet model (MC) group, and groups receiving 20%, 30% or 40% EL (n = 8 per group).

pmc-13676726.title: Harnessing hydrogel technology for advanced periodontitis therapy: A multifunctional approach to oral health restoration
pmc-13676726.creator: Xiaoqing Zhuo, Shaoqiang Wang, Li-Yuan Liu, Minmin Zhu, Zhenjiang Zhang, Yuqi Zhou, Maoshan Wang, Xudong Deng, Yanxia Miao, Niannian Li, Xue-Ting Wang, Hongguang Zhu
pmc-13676726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryPeriodontitis is a bacterially driven inflammatory disease that can lead to tooth mobility and tooth loss. Conventional non-surgical therapy, antibiotics, and surgery may be limited by residual subgingival biofilms, antimicrobial resistance, and variable clinical outcomes. This review synthesizes recent studies of hydrogel-based systems for local periodontal therapy, focusing on stimuli-responsive release mechanisms, cargo-loading approaches, and regenerative outcomes in relevant animal models.

pmc-13682000.title: Molecular mechanism of augmentation of oncogenic activity of MYC by TAF2 in HCC
pmc-13682000.creator: Suchismita Raha, Qiong Zhang, Devon Farrar, Charles Tseng, Rachel G Mendoza, Rabha M Younis, Kayla A Rodriguez, Samyukta Iyer, Mark A Subler, Jolene J Windle, Zhao Lai, Mikhail Dozmorov, Jamy C Peng, Devanand Sarkar
pmc-13682000.description: The oncogenes MYC and TAF2 (TATA-box binding protein associated factor 2) are frequently overexpressed and co-amplified in many cancers, including hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We recently demonstrated that overexpression of TAF2 in mouse liver markedly augmented MYC overexpression-induced HCC. MYC is a transcription factor. TAF2 is a component of transcription factor IID (TFIID) and functions as a transcription co-factor.
